subject.title: Feishu plugin WebSocket doesn't receive im.message.receive_v1 events

question: Should a Feishu-capable maintainer run credentialed current-main WebSocket QA for this lifecycle-events-present but message-events-missing report before any cleanup or repair decision?
rationale: The source path is wired and a related startup fix has merged, but only live Feishu evidence can separate platform subscription, SDK dispatch, and OpenClaw parsing/routing failures for this exact symptom.

options.title: Run Feishu live diagnostics
options.body: Use a real Feishu/Lark app with `im.message.receive_v1` enabled, capture redacted SDK and gateway logs for lifecycle and message events, then scope the repair from the observed drop point.

options.title: Fold into broader inbound issue
options.body: Treat this as partial overlap with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92595 only if maintainers confirm the same post-https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94013 failure mode covers both reports.

options.title: Close as external setup
options.body: Close only if live evidence shows OpenClaw receives the expected events on current main and the remaining failure is solely Feishu developer-console setup outside this repository.

recommendation.title: Run Feishu live diagnostics
recommendation.body: Use a real Feishu/Lark app with `im.message.receive_v1` enabled, capture redacted SDK and gateway logs for lifecycle and message events, then scope the repair from the observed drop point.
